name: Daily Command
description: Daily Command continuously observes your brands, campaigns, budgets, and market signals - then recommends, routes approval, executes, and measures the next best move. Where commercial teams stop assembling dashboards and start acting.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Daily Command to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Daily Command to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai-workspace.doceree.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Daily Command MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Daily Command lists 54 MCP tools, including analyze_clinical_activity, analyze_universe, competitive_trends, detect_anomalies, fetch, fetch_campaign_catalog, get_analytics_result, get_aqs_summary, get_audience_engagement, get_available_audiences, get_brand_challenges, and get_brand_ndcs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Daily Command?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Daily Command in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Daily Command MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Daily Command requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Daily Command is developed by Doceree Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
